name: Manorbier Country Park
stayType: Holiday park with caravans and touring pitches
accommodation: Graded holiday homes (Bronze to Platinum) and touring pitches; sister park Manorbier Bay Holiday Park nearby
beachAccess: Described as a stone's throw from a sandy beach
confirmedFeatures: Indoor heated pool, evening entertainment, café, playground, hook-ups
overview: Manorbier Country Park is a holiday park near Manorbier offering graded caravan holiday homes and touring pitches, with an indoor heated pool and family entertainment. Its smaller sister park, Manorbier Bay, is a few minutes' walk away and shares the facilities.
surfTripFit: Good for families mixing surf at Manorbier with pool and entertainment for those who are not in the water.
